title: wildmat_match is O(m^n) backtracking — LIST ACTIVE DoS
description: reader/src/session/commands/list.rs:21-36: wildmat_match is a recursive backtracking matcher. For each * in the pattern, it tries all O(m) prefix lengths of the remaining text and recurses. For a pattern with n stars and a group name of length m, worst case is O(m^n). A client sending LIST ACTIVE *.*.*.*.*.*  against a server with 100,000 groups triggers this for every group name: a 20-character group name with 6 dots in the pattern runs ~20^6 = 64M recursive calls per group. Multiply by 100k groups and the server is unresponsive for minutes. Fix: replace with an iterative matcher using standard dynamic programming or convert to a compiled regex. Alternatively, limit the number of * wildcards accepted in a wildmat pattern to 2 or 3 and reject with 501 if exceeded.
